source: REH13 act 1 record page (docs/evidence/runtime/reh13/act1.json on task/reh13-rehearsal): building 1084419, record a69cdab3 revision 2, card 93fd4362 revision 1, register row 'gpmc-yuvp.csv, CSV logical row 444'

items.item: Property Card: Blocked: select a unit with an assigned proposed code
cause: apps/studio/src/features/register/RegisterPage.tsx computed the line in Studio from the unit selection only: with no unit selected it was always Blocked.

The page never read the building's own card. The batch card step writes it on the building's intake target (artefacts.card, artefacts.evidence.record), which only the map inspector (BuildingCard) read.
fix: New apps/studio/src/features/register/PropertyCardAction.tsx: cardOffer() reads the intake target by feature (the same query key and read as the map inspector). A carded target offers its card: 'Card <id> · revision <n> · cites record revision <m>', where the record revision is artefacts.evidence.record, or artefacts.record when the card has no confirmed evidence.
The Property Card button opens the existing BuildingCardDialog (Open card PDF, Verification, Card consistent).
The Blocked line stays only when no card exists and no unit is selected, or when a selected unit has no code and no listed card. The server was not changed for this item; no card state is invented.

items.item: Documents tab lists only buildings-original.geojson feature 1084419, not the register row
cause: The tab lists ledger.sources from GET /api/v1/buildings/{id}/ledger.

packages/server/src/modules/officer/building-ledger.ts cited the root feature, record evidence, edges, parcels and identifiers. Its records come through publicRegistryBody, which withholds documentCitations, so the confirmed register row on revision 2 was never cited.
fix: Server, building-ledger.ts: documentCitationLocators() reads body.documentCitations stored on the current revision of the building's related records. Each citation is cited by its source and locator in words: a table row by tableRowLocatorWords ('CSV logical row 444'), a native part by its locator label, any other kind by its source and citation id.

Those sources go through the same authorizeLedgerSources / registryRecordedSourceTx path as every ledger source. Pins, quotes and excerpts do not leave the read. A stored citation that does not parse is counted in the ledger's missing notes and is not listed.
Studio, api/ledger.ts: a cited row locator ('CSV logical row N' or 'Sheet S, row N') is a table source. The existing SourceList and EvidenceChip show it with its source name and locator.
The API contract shape is unchanged (sources[].locators gains entries), so neither openapi nor studio:api-types was needed.

cases: a building with a card shows that card, its revision and the record revision it cites; no Blocked line (REH13 ids)
a card made with no confirmed evidence cites the revision its target records (captured E3B target)
a building with no card and no unit code keeps the Blocked line and a disabled button
a selected unit keeps its own card flow
